newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas slides again in busier trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas slides again in busier trade.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures continued to fall on Friday with deals done as much as 0.50 pence a therm below Thursday's settlement levels.
Front month March settled at 10.50 pence, down 0.325 pence from Thursday and a full 4.40 pence below the contract high on only the tenth day since it started.
This fall keeps March in contango to April and May, and flat against June, July and August.
"There was a bit of construcive activity today, mostly in the second half of the morning," said a broker. "It's been a much tighter market and people are now saying that there's value here."
Futures prices have continued to follow down levels on the physical market, brokers said.

"The OTC market's weak, there's slightly more gas around than people would like," said one. He added that most players had expected the market from March to be backwardated into the summer, and the fact that there is a contango instead is creating some potential opportunities.

A total of 225 lots were traded, including every one of the 12 monthly contracts except October 1997 and February 1998. The volumes traded have crept higher in the second half of the week after hitting a low of only 35 lots on Tuesday.
